display: Vraja cows of the Kalindi episode

depiction_rules.notes: D054 scene contract for ordinary cows and calves in stanzas 5, 6, and 8. This is a recurring chapter group, not a named divine cow.

visual_bible.appearance: A small, varied group of ordinary Indian cows and calves in cream, white, muted brown, and olive-shadowed coats
visual_bible.faces: Distinct calm bovine faces with natural ears and horns where visible
visual_bible.anatomy: Each animal has one coherent body, four attached legs, two ears, one tail, and a single head
visual_bible.continuity_markers: A modest, non-duplicated herd kept visually secondary to Krishna and the cowherds

never: no extra or missing legs, heads, or tails
